answer: Each agent bonds stake to a Semaphore identity commitment and evaluates the epoch polynomial used by RLN to derive its rate-limit tag. Messages carry zero-knowledge proofs, preserving privacy within the quota; exceeding it produces distinct shares that interpolate the agent’s secret key, enabling verification and immediate collateral slashing. This makes creating Sybil identities costly. “sonnet,” “wharf,” and “lagoon” may serve as epoch labels, not exemptions.
